companies.name: グーグル(アルファベット)

relations.text: 検索結果に表示する有料広告の大半をGoogleから受け取る
relations.text_en: Google supplies most of the paid listings shown by Ask Media Group

source.label: People Inc 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: The majority of the paid listings displayed by Ask Media Group is supplied to us by Google Inc. (“Google”) pursuant to our services agreement with Google, dated as of October 26, 2015 and as subsequently amended (the “Services Agreement”).

relations.text: Apple News+との関係からコンテンツのライセンス収入を得る
relations.text_en: Earns content licensing royalties from its relationship with Apple News+

source.label: People Inc 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: Content licensing royalties are earned from our relationship with Apple News+ as well as other content use and distribution relationships, including utilization in large-language models and other artificial intelligence (“AI”) related activities.

relations.text: 検索キーワード広告をGoogleに加えてMicrosoftからも購入する
relations.text_en: Buys search keywords from Microsoft as well as Google

source.label: People Inc 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: We have made, and expect to continue to make, significant expenditures for search engine marketing primarily in the form of the purchase of keywords, which we purchase primarily through Google and, to a lesser extent, Microsoft and Yahoo!

companies.name: メタ・プラットフォームズ

relations.text: 集客と配信をAppleやGoogleなどのプラットフォームに頼り、Metaもその1つ
relations.text_en: Relies on distribution platforms operated by firms including Meta

source.label: People Inc 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: We rely on search engines, digital app stores, advertising networks, social media platforms, and other third-party content discovery and distribution platforms (particularly those operated by Apple, Google, Microsoft, Meta and Amazon)

relations.text: 集客と配信をAmazonなどのプラットフォームに頼る
relations.text_en: Relies on distribution platforms operated by firms including Amazon

source.label: People Inc 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: We rely on search engines, digital app stores, advertising networks, social media platforms, and other third-party content discovery and distribution platforms (particularly those operated by Apple, Google, Microsoft, Meta and Amazon)

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
